package lib

type Filters []func(int) bool

func NewFilters() Filters {
	return Filters{}
}

func (f Filters) Add(predicate func(int) bool) Filters {
	return append(f, predicate)
}

func (f Filters) Match(candidate int) bool {
	for _, predicate := range f {
		if !predicate(candidate) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func GreaterThan(threshold int) func(int) bool {
	return func(value int) bool { return value > threshold }
}

func LessThan(threshold int) func(int) bool {
	return func(value int) bool { return value < threshold }
}

func NotEqual(other int) func(int) bool {
	return func(value int) bool { return value != other }
}
